text:
marta: FYI orbitpay on dedicated dc-nyc-3 pool-5 started seeing a big spike of 429s + p99 > 3s at 11:03 UTC. They report 'auth errors' but responses are 429. Header shows eviction hints. Can someone triage? :eyes:

alex: can you paste a raw response with headers + request id? also which model variant and pool size?

marta: sample response headers (from customer):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Request-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d
X-RW-Evict: shard=17;evict_rate=23/s;frag=0.71
X-RW-KV-Usage: session_kv=88%;heap_frag=0.34
Content-Type: application/json
```
body: {"error":"rate_limit","message":"kv cache eviction throttle"}
model: gptx-large-32b, dedicated: pool-5 (8xA100)

chris: that X-RW-Evict pattern + high session_kv suggests KV cache churn from long-context sessions. Orbitpay's usage spike last night matches lots of 700k-1M token contexts. When the KV slab compacts it temporarily reduces usable cache and we hit throttling -> 429.

marta: we reproduced this in a lab run. Sending 40 concurrent sessions with ~1MB prefills gives ~30% 429s within 90s. Repro curl: 
```bash
for i in {1..40}; do \
  curl -sS -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"gptx-large-32b","input":"<1MB_context_here>","stream":true}' \
    https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &\n done\nwait\n```
Responses include same X-RW-Evict header.

tessa: checking node logs now — I see repeated lines: 
```
rw_kv: shard=17 evict_loop start rate=22/s target=20
rw_kv: reclaim: bytes=+120MB freed=0 overhead=frag:0.67
memory: warn heap_frag_high=0.36 jemalloc_chunk_retained=120MB
```
Also a few warnings about slab compaction taking >250ms which correlates with p99 latency.

kevin: is autoscaler reacting? it may be backing off if eviction events look like noisy neighbor. If pool autoscale cooldown is long we won't regain capacity in time. I see recent scale events: +2 GPUs at 10:58, then backoff at 11:05.

alex: quick mitigations we can try:
- enable route-level prefix_cache for orbitpay (reduces session_kv pressure)
- temporarily lower session_kv.max_context_bytes on their tenant to 256k
- pin them to a quantized model variant to reduce KV size per token

chris: also adding a short-term circuit: if eviction_rate > 15/s we can surface a 429 that suggests 'try smaller context' instead of opaque auth error. But we should avoid reactive autoscale backoff that treats sustained evictions as a signal to reduce traffic.

marta: can someone post exact kubectl logs/grep we should run? I can run in staging.

tessa: run on any node in pool-5: 
```bash
kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=pool-5 -c runtime | grep -E "rw_kv|evict|heap_frag|jemalloc" --line-buffered | tail -n 200
```
Look for lines like `rw_kv: shard=.. evict_loop` and `heap_frag_high`.

chris: repro script for staging (small):
```bash
# repro.sh - creates 8 concurrent longctx sessions
for i in {1..8}; do 
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"gptx-large-32b","input":"'$LONG_CTX'","stream":false}' \
    https://staging-api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
 done
wait
```
Add `--repeat 50` to amplify.

support-bot: incident: INC-2026 created for orbitpay 429 spike; severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026

kevin: short-term action: I'll open a hotfix to increase pool autoscale burst by +2 for dc-nyc-3 and add an autoscale cooldown override for 20m. If that doesn't help, we'll throttle orbitpay at the loadbalancer to gradual ramp.

alex: I'll patch routing config to enable prefix_cache for the tenant and set session_kv.max_context_bytes=262144 for their route. chris and tessa can validate slab logs after.

marta: assigning: kevin -> autoscale hotfix, alex -> route change, tessa -> verify logs + slab compaction metrics, chris -> update repro harness and run in staging. I'll notify orbitpay support with suggested mitigations and ETA 30m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started on pool-5 (dc-nyc-3) by kevin at 11:25 UTC

marta: thanks team — will post followup in 30m with updated p99 and eviction metrics.
